entities.name: Mujahideen Resistance and Soviet Withdrawal
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Mujahideen Resistance and Soviet Withdrawal, a transformative movement in Afghanistan (1980–1992). Emerged from Geneva Accord and Soviet Union invades Afghanistan with 100,000 troops. Catalyzed US supplies Stinger missiles to mujahideen, shifting the air war and Soviet forces complete withdrawal from Afghanistan.
